qe: Which city hosted the UN Climate Change Conference COP29 in November 2024?
qh: नवंबर 2024 में संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु परिवर्तन सम्मेलन COP29 किस शहर में आयोजित हुआ?
e: COP29 was held in Baku, Azerbaijan.

qe: In 2024, which country became the first to explicitly protect abortion rights in its national constitution?
qh: 2024 में राष्ट्रीय संविधान में गर्भपात के अधिकार की स्पष्ट रक्षा करने वाला पहला देश कौन बना?
e: France amended its Constitution in 2024 to explicitly include the freedom to have an abortion.

qe: India's National Space Day is observed on 23 August to mark which achievement?
qh: भारत में 23 अगस्त को राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष दिवस किस उपलब्धि की स्मृति में मनाया जाता है?
oe: The start of the Mars mission
e: National Space Day commemorates Chandrayaan-3's successful landing near the Moon's south polar region on 23 August 2023.

qe: What simple interest is earned on ₹5,000 at 6% per year for 2 years?
qh: ₹5,000 पर 6% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्षों में कितना साधारण ब्याज मिलेगा?
e: Simple interest = principal × rate × time ÷ 100 = 5,000 × 6 × 2 ÷ 100 = ₹600.

qe: Which molecule stores usable energy released during cellular respiration?
qh: कोशिकीय श्वसन के दौरान मुक्त उपयोगी ऊर्जा किस अणु में संचित होती है?
e: Cells transfer much of the energy released in respiration to ATP.

qe: Which device is commonly treated as a non-ohmic conductor because its resistance changes as it heats?
qh: गर्म होने पर जिसका प्रतिरोध बदलता है, ऐसा कौन-सा उपकरण सामान्यतः गैर-ओमिक चालक माना जाता है?
oe: A copper wire at constant temperature
A switch in the closed position
oh: स्थिर ताप पर ताँबे का तार
e: A bulb filament heats up as current flows, so its resistance changes and the device is non-ohmic.

qe: After entering a human through a mosquito bite, where do malaria parasites first multiply?
qh: मच्छर के काटने से मानव शरीर में प्रवेश करने के बाद मलेरिया परजीवी सबसे पहले कहाँ बढ़ते हैं?
e: The parasite first infects liver cells before entering red blood cells.

qe: What is the chemical formula of water?
qh: पानी का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
e: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom: H₂O.

qe: What happens to blue litmus paper in an acidic solution?
qh: अम्लीय विलयन में नीले लिटमस पत्र का क्या होता है?
oe: It remains blue in every case
oh: वह हर स्थिति में नीला रहता है
e: Acids turn blue litmus red.

qe: Which metal is widely used for electrical wiring because it conducts electricity well?
qh: अच्छी विद्युत चालकता के कारण तार बनाने में किस धातु का व्यापक उपयोग होता है?
e: Copper is a good electrical conductor and is commonly used in wiring.

qe: What is the SI unit of force?
qh: बल का SI मात्रक क्या है?
e: Force is measured in newtons (N).

qe: In which city is the High Court of Bihar located?
qh: बिहार उच्च न्यायालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: The High Court of Bihar is located in Patna.

qe: Who was the first President of the Republic of India?
qh: भारत गणराज्य के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति कौन थे?
e: Dr Rajendra Prasad was India's first President.

qe: The ruins of the ancient Nalanda Mahavihara are in which present-day state?
qh: प्राचीन नालंदा महाविहार के अवशेष वर्तमान में किस राज्य में हैं?
e: Nalanda Mahavihara is an ancient learning centre in present-day Bihar.

qe: Which Bihar city is especially known for its silk products?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा शहर अपने रेशमी उत्पादों के लिए विशेष रूप से प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Bhagalpur is widely associated with silk weaving and silk products.

qe: Which river is often called the 'Sorrow of Bihar' because of its floods?
qh: बाढ़ के कारण किस नदी को प्रायः 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
e: The Kosi has historically caused severe flooding across parts of Bihar.

qe: Which major river flows across Bihar from west to east?
qh: कौन-सी प्रमुख नदी बिहार में पश्चिम से पूर्व की ओर बहती है?
e: The Ganga flows across Bihar broadly from west to east.

qe: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी का सबसे बड़ा महासागर कौन-सा है?
e: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean by area.

qe: About how long does Earth take to rotate once on its axis?
qh: पृथ्वी को अपनी धुरी पर एक बार घूमने में लगभग कितना समय लगता है?
e: One rotation takes about one day, or 24 hours.

qe: Which Indian state has the largest area?
qh: क्षेत्रफल के अनुसार भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य कौन-सा है?
e: Rajasthan is India's largest state by area.

qe: In which city is the National Library of India located?
qh: राष्ट्रीय पुस्तकालय भारत किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: The National Library of India is located in Kolkata.

qe: On which date was the Constitution of India adopted by the Constituent Assembly?
qh: संविधान सभा ने भारत का संविधान किस तारीख को अंगीकृत किया?
e: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949; it came into force on 26 January 1950.

qe: The major uprising against British rule in 1857 began at which place?
qh: 1857 में ब्रिटिश शासन के विरुद्ध बड़ा विद्रोह किस स्थान से शुरू हुआ?
e: The uprising of 1857 began at Meerut and then spread to other centres.

qe: What is the capital of Nepal?
qh: नेपाल की राजधानी क्या है?
e: Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.

qe: What is 25% of 240?
e: 25% is one quarter; 240 ÷ 4 = 60.

qe: What is three-fifths of 100?
qh: 100 का तीन-पाँचवाँ भाग कितना है?
e: Three-fifths of 100 is 100 × 3 ÷ 5 = 60.

qe: If 2x + 5 = 17, what is x?
qh: यदि 2x + 5 = 17, तो x का मान क्या है?
e: Subtract 5 to get 2x = 12, then divide by 2: x = 6.

qe: What is the sum of the interior angles of a triangle?
qh: त्रिभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग कितना होता है?
e: The interior angles of every triangle add up to 180°.

qe: Which instrument measures atmospheric pressure?
qh: वायुमंडलीय दबाव मापने वाला यंत्र कौन-सा है?
e: A barometer is used to measure atmospheric pressure.

qe: Which planet is the largest in our Solar System?
qh: हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह कौन-सा है?
e: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
